title: NO CLOSES IN 0:00 ON A RING STILL RUNNING
why: Found by the review of the night builds (2026-10-09). A ring called before its closing time keeps running past it, and the closing row added in v21.15 then read closes in 0:00 on a ring that was still open. Past the closing time the row is now left off, and the call or the extraction in progress shows alone.
now: The map no longer says closes in 0:00 on an extraction that is still running.
